_comment: Anthropic API list prices (USD per 1M tokens, input/output) — re-grounded 2026-09-05 from platform.claude.com/docs/en/about-claude/models/overview.md (Fable 5.1 $10/$50 · Opus 5 $5/$25 · Sonnet 5 $2/$10 · Haiku 4.5 $1/$5, all four confirmed live). SONNET was corrected 2026-09-04 from a stale $3/$15. CACHE MULTIPLIERS are × the input price: `_cache` is the DEFAULT, `_model_cache` holds per-model-id EXCEPTIONS resolved by LONGEST PREFIX. The live footnote reads: 'prompt cache reads cost 10% of the base input price (2.5% on Claude Fable 5.1 and Claude Mythos 5.1)'. That exception cannot live on a FAMILY key: `claude-code/fable` covers both `claude-fable-5` (10%) and `claude-fable-5-1` (2.5%), and in the live 30-day window this box ran 76.3% of its fable-tier tokens on claude-fable-5 and 23.7% on claude-fable-5-1 — a family-level 0.025 would trade a 4× overprice on the smaller share for a 4× UNDERprice on the larger one. Cache reads are the dominant term, so this is not rounding. ⚠️ WHO ACTUALLY GETS THE OVERRIDE, measured 2026-09-05 — `claude_p_cost.api_equiv` and `derive_cost.amortized_by_family` (which has the real model id in hand). WHO DOES NOT: `derive_cost.api_equiv`, which is FAMILY-keyed by construction, and ANY caller passing a bare tier alias — which today is every caller in this repo (`claude_p_cost.main --model`, `rivals_run.CLAUDE_P_MODELS`). An alias names a tier that runs BOTH models and is genuinely unresolvable, so TREAT ANY FABLE-TIER api_equiv COMPUTED FROM AN ALIAS AS AN UPPER BOUND. Closing that half needs callers to carry real model ids, not another price row. ⚠️ `/opt/ai-model-catalog/engine/` keeps its OWN copy of this file with no `_model_cache` and the stale $3/$15 sonnet — it is a separate repo and a cross-repo HARD STOP from here; filed, not edited.
